description: Canonical operator registry for the TriadicFrameworks MCP substrate.

operators.name: bind
operators.definition: Creates a coherence attachment between two resonance surfaces.
operators.semantics: Binding establishes a stable relationship between fields or surfaces, enabling structured interaction.

operators.name: pull
operators.definition: Draws a resonance surface inward toward a coherence anchor.
operators.semantics: Pulling reduces separation and increases coherence density.

operators.name: push
operators.definition: Applies outward force to a resonance surface, increasing separation.
operators.semantics: Pushing expands structure and reduces local coherence.

operators.name: gradient
operators.definition: Measures or induces change across a resonance field.
operators.semantics: Gradients describe directional change and are used to evaluate structural transitions.

operators.name: fieldShift
operators.definition: Shifts a resonance field into a new alignment or regime.
operators.semantics: Field shifts alter the underlying coherence regime and can trigger structural transitions.

operators.name: ruptureForce
operators.definition: Applies force sufficient to rupture a resonance surface.
operators.semantics: Rupture force breaks continuity and produces a discontinuity event.
